title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The resilience to future emergencies in Afghanistan programme implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to build the resilience of displaced and host communities affected by conflict and natural disasters by providing for their immediate survival needs and supporting them to gain the infrastructure and skills to be more resilient to future emergencies. The objectives of the programme is to provide emergency provisions and shelter, cash, and winterization support; to work with communities and provincial authorities in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces to manage and improve their emergency response in an effective and timely manner; and to support the disaster response capacity of local NGO partners. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: IDPs and Host communities affected by conflict and natural disasters in Takhar, Kunduz and Badakhshan have their immediate survival needs met, and gain infrastructure and skills to be more resilient to future emergencies..
